answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a small refundable bond that burns like an ember if the identity is caught attesting falsely, while its reputation grows slowly like a cedar - rooted over many verified epochs, not bought overnight. Attackers face a spiral: each fake identity costs a fresh bond plus months of honest work to mature, so creating thousands of sockpuppets multiplies the cost linearly while the payoff stays flat, and the bond makes fake attestations self-defeating.
